rule.signal: Form 4/5 code P, non-derivative common equity/ADR, shares>0 & price>0; one $10,000 position per SEC accession+ticker
rule.entry: regular-session OPEN of first trading day strictly after the SEC filing date
rule.exit: regular-session CLOSE 252 sessions (~1 trading year) after entry; delisted names exit at last observed close and are flagged
rule.prices: Yahoo Finance full-history daily bars, Stooq then Nasdaq fallback; cached per ticker
rule.no_lookahead: entry never at/before filing date and never the insider price; exit only from observed sessions
